submissions.title: bKash/Nagad payments to check
submissions.intro: When a guardian sends money by bKash or Nagad and gives the TrxID, it shows here. Check it in the institute’s own app and verify it: a receipt is made and the money comes off the dues.
submissions.countPending: {n, plural, one {{count} payment waiting to be checked} other {{count} payments waiting to be checked}}
submissions.emptyPending: No payments are waiting to be checked.
submissions.emptyPendingHint: They show here when a guardian sends money by bKash or Nagad and gives the TrxID. If a guardian tells you by phone, record it yourself with the button above.
submissions.verifyCheckTitle: Check it in your own app first
submissions.verifyCheck: In the institute’s own {method} app, find this TrxID among the payments to {account}. Verify only if the money arrived and the amount matches.
submissions.verifyAfter: Verifying makes a receipt and takes the money off the dues. Only the owner or an admin can void the receipt later.
submissions.errAlreadyReviewed: This payment has already been checked. The list has been refreshed.
submissions.errTrxUsed: Money has already been taken with this TrxID. The same money cannot be taken twice, so return this one.
submissions.errAmountExceeds: Some of the dues this money was sent for have been paid since, so the amount is now more than they owe. Choose dues or months to pay ahead below, or return the payment.
submissions.repickShort: Choose dues of at least the amount sent ({amount}).
submissions.repickNone: This student has no dues and no months to pay ahead now. Return the payment.
submissions.rejectBody: Return it if the money did not arrive or the amount does not match. The guardian will see the reason.
submissions.rejectPlaceholder: e.g. No money arrived with this TrxID
submissions.rejectShort: Give a reason of at least 3 characters.

record.title: Record a bKash/Nagad payment
record.hint: When a guardian gives you the TrxID by phone or in person, record it here. It joins the list to check: match it in the institute’s app, then verify it.
record.search: Search by name, ID or roll
record.noMatch: No one found. Check the spelling or the ID and search again.
record.picked: {n, plural, one {{count} chosen, {amount}} other {{count} chosen, {amount} in all}}
record.tooManyDues: Choose at most 24 dues at a time.
record.noAccounts: The institute has no {method} number yet.
record.amountTooMuch: Cannot be more than the chosen dues ({amount}).
record.trxHint: The transaction ID in the bKash/Nagad message, e.g. 8N7A6D5C4B
record.trxInvalid: A TrxID has 6 to 20 English letters and digits.
record.submit: Add to the list to check
record.saved: Recorded. Now match it in the app and verify it.
record.errTrxUsed: This TrxID has already been used.
record.errTooMany: This student’s earlier payments must be checked before another can be recorded.
record.errAccountInactive: This number is no longer used. Choose another.
record.errAmountExceeds: More than the chosen dues owe. They owe {amount} now.

dues.duesIntro: Who owes what, with fines up to today.
dues.defaultersIntro: Students with overdue dues: for how long and how much.
dues.totalRow: Total, {n, plural, one {{count} student} other {{count} students}}
dues.emptyDuesHint: Every fee is paid, or no dues have been made yet.
dues.emptyDefaultersHint: Try fewer days or a smaller amount.
dues.cardOpenDues: {n, plural, one {{count} fee owed} other {{count} fees owed}}

collections.intro: Money collected in a period, void receipts left out.
collections.empty: Nothing was collected in this period.
collections.rangeBackwards: The end date cannot be before the start.
collections.rangeTooLong: At most a year at a time.
collections.headNote: A receipt that paid several fees counts under each of them, so the total receipts can be fewer than the sum of the rows.

reminders.title: Due reminder SMS
reminders.intro: Remind guardians of overdue fees by SMS. No one gets two reminders for the same due.
reminders.stale: The filters changed. Count again before sending.
reminders.segmentsHint: A long message counts as more than one SMS.
reminders.wouldBeHeld: {n, plural, one {{count} SMS falls over today’s limit and will not go out today.} other {{count} SMS fall over today’s limit and will not go out today.}}
reminders.noneToSend: No one to send to now.
reminders.noneToSendHint: Everyone with overdue fees has been reminded already, or their guardian has no phone number.
reminders.nobody: No one is overdue on these terms.
reminders.send: {n, plural, one {Send SMS to {count} guardian} other {Send SMS to {count} guardians}}
reminders.confirmTitle: {n, plural, one {Send an SMS to {count} guardian?} other {Send SMS to {count} guardians?}}
reminders.confirmBody: Each one is checked again just before it goes: if the fee has been paid by then, no SMS is sent.
reminders.changed: The count changed in the meantime: {count} now. Check the new count and send again.
reminders.runQueued: {n, plural, one {{count} SMS lined up to send.} other {{count} SMS lined up to send.}}
reminders.runNothing: There was no one to send to.
reminders.runStopped: The status is taking a while. Check again in a moment.
